stem:
Bharat finds a cell for a torch. Its electrolyte is a moist paste, not a free liquid.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: It is a dry cell because the electrolyte is not a free liquid, so it is convenient for everyday use.
It is a Voltaic cell because it has two terminals and an electrolyte.
It is a Voltaic cell because a paste electrolyte is used only in Voltaic cells.
It is a dry cell only when used in a torch, not in any other everyday device.

teacher.key_rationale: A dry cell holds electrolyte as a paste rather than a free liquid, which makes everyday use convenient. Calling it a Voltaic cell from shared terminals swaps the cell type. Saying paste belongs only to Voltaic cells reverses the classification cue. Limiting dry cells to torches alone over-narrows everyday use.

mx_swap.reason: Ignoring paste-vs-liquid inside the key claim duplicates term_substitution; used scope_error on torch-only use instead.
